name: Mikuni Yuuichi
source:
He is Yuji's older brother and Manami's husband.

He is a big man with a soft personality who can get away with most things with a smile.

He is abnormally devoted to his younger brother. He's a bit of a brocon.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/tmhv.html]official site[/url]]
